name: 37th Bangkok Marathon
short_description: The 37th Bangkok Marathon takes place January 10, 2027, beside the Grand Palace in Bangkok, offering full marathon, half marathon, and 10 km distances.
ai_summary: The 37th Bangkok Marathon is scheduled for January 10, 2027, starting near Sanam Chai Road beside the Grand Palace in Bangkok, Thailand. The event offers three distances: a full marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), and a 10 km race.

core_facts.venue: Sanam Chai Road, beside the Grand Palace, Bangkok
core_facts.organizer: Jogging Association of Thailand (สมาคมนักวิ่งเพื่อสุขภาพแห่งประเทศไทย)

pros: Iconic, historic venue beside the Grand Palace in Bangkok
Multiple distance options (42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km) to suit different runners
Long-running event, now in its 37th edition, suggesting established organization

faqs.question: When is the 37th Bangkok Marathon?
faqs.answer: The 37th Bangkok Marathon is scheduled to take place on January 10, 2027. This date marks the running of the event's main race day, which includes the full marathon, half marathon, and 10 km distances, all starting from the same central Bangkok venue.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: The race starts and is centered around Sanam Chai Road, located beside the Grand Palace in Bangkok, Thailand. This central, historic location in the city serves as the venue for all three race distances offered during the event.

faqs.question: What distances are offered?
faqs.answer: The 37th Bangkok Marathon offers three distance options for participants: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, and a shorter 10 km race, allowing runners of different experience levels to take part.

faqs.question: When can I register for the race?
faqs.answer: According to the available information, nationwide registration is set to begin on July 1, 2026, so prospective participants will need to wait until that date to sign up.
